method: Aggregate queries only (count / group by) against each city's public permit feed. No bulk row downloads.

cities.base_power_2026_note: About 300 backup-battery permits filed Aug-Sep 2026 (from prior work in this repo, house/permits.py).
Only open dataset is 'Residential Building Permits by Month and Year', a pre-aggregated count with no per-permit contractor field. Base Power cannot be counted from Houston's open data.
Feed has a contractor field, but the dataset is stale (max issued_date seen: 2019-12-31). 0 rows match contractor LIKE '%BASE POWER%' in the whole dataset. Cannot answer 2026.
Socrata catalog listed 'Development Permits' at data.fortworthtexas.gov, but the domain now 302-redirects to hub.arcgis.com/legacy. No working endpoint found within the time budget.

Schema has FOLDERTYPE, WORKDESC, NameofBusiness, no contractor field. 0 hits searching NameofBusiness for 'BASE POWER', but that field is not documented as the installing contractor, so this is inconclusive rather than a confirmed zero.
Plano has a GIS open-data hub (data-planogis.opendata.arcgis.com) but its dataset catalog feed errored and no permits dataset was found within the time budget.
Frisco Hub (geodata-frisco.hub.arcgis.com) catalog has 35 datasets, none of them a permits dataset.
McKinney's GIS open-data site has 56 datasets. The only permit-related ones are Health Food Permits and Permitted Hunting Areas; no building/electrical permit dataset.
